typography.instructions: Use Cabinet Grotesk (or another premium geometric sans like General Sans/Outfit) for strong, confident headlines with tight tracking (tracking-tighter). Use Inter for highly legible body text. Use JetBrains Mono for overlines, technical labels, architecture nodes, and tech stack tags. AVOID Inter for headings.

colors.instructions: Vercel/Linear dark aesthetic. Pure black is strictly banned; use #0A0A0A as the base. Structure the UI with 1px subtle borders (#262626). The accent color (cyan) is highly restrained—use it ONLY for active data flow particles, hover glows, and terminal/code highlights to maintain a serious engineering vibe.

visual_enhancers.noise: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity 0.02 to 0.04) fixed over the entire viewport to give a tactile, premium texture.
visual_enhancers.grid: Use a subtle 1px grid line background (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) to mimic engineering/math paper without distracting from content.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating sticky elements like the navigation bar. Formula: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 border-b border-white/10. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for nav.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Cards should use a crisp 1px border shift on hover (e.g., border-white/20) and a very subtle inner glow. Avoid muddy drop shadows in dark mode.

motion.lenis: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling globally for a premium, weighty momentum feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using framer-motion. Staggered reveal of H1, subtext, and CTA buttons.
motion.scroll_animations: Staggered fade-up reveals for sections and bento grid cards when they intersect the viewport.
motion.marquee: One slow, smooth editorial marquee for the technology stack. Use react-fast-marquee or framer-motion. Style as text-transparent stroke-white/20 with large typography.
motion.pipeline_animation: Subtle animated data-flow visualization. Use framer-motion to trace SVG paths with glowing cyan dots representing data moving from Sources -> Ingestion -> Processing -> Data Lake.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in a check for prefers-reduced-motion to ensure accessibility.

components.name: Hero Section
components.instructions: Large confident typography. H1 fluid sizing (clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem)). Layout: Text on the left (col-span-7), Data Flow Canvas on the right (col-span-5). Include two CTAs: 'Explore My Work' (primary, sharp/pill) and 'View Resume' (secondary/outline).

components.name: Data Flow Canvas (Visualization)
components.instructions: Animated pipeline showing Sources -> Ingestion -> Processing -> Data Lake -> Platform -> Analytics/AI. Nodes should be labeled with monospace font (Kafka, S3, Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, dbt). Glowing cyan particles flow through connecting SVG lines.

components.name: Sticky Nav
components.instructions: Fixed at top, z-50, glassmorphism background. Logo (Minhaz Alam) left, nav links center, Resume CTA right. Include Recruiter Mode toggle.

components.name: Credibility Stat Band
components.instructions: Full width, subtle top/bottom border. 3-4 key metrics (e.g., PB of data processed, Uptime, Pipelines built) using monospace counters.

components.name: Case Study Cards
components.instructions: Linear-style project cards. Flat background, 1px border. Hover state lifts the card slightly and highlights the border. Include tech stack tags in monospace.

components.name: Interactive Architecture Viewer
components.instructions: A split pane or modal layout. Clickable architecture diagram nodes. When a node is clicked, the side pane displays 'Why this?', 'Alternatives considered', and 'Tradeoffs'.

components.name: Skills Bento Grid
components.instructions: Bento layout categorizing skills (Languages, Cloud, Processing, DW). Dense spacing (gap-4). High contrast layout mimicking a modern data dashboard.

components.name: Interactive Playgrounds
components.instructions: Include a SQL playground / PySpark demo section. Terminal-like UI with a dark background, syntax highlighting, and a 'Run' button simulating data output.

grids_and_layouts.bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6 for tight, dashboard-like density.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous vertical rhythm. Use py-24 or py-32 between major sections to let the content breathe.

libraries.icons: lucide-react, react-icons (for brand logos like AWS, Snowflake, Python, Databricks)
libraries.ui_components: shadcn/ui primitives customized for the dark linear aesthetic

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text (#FAFAFA) and secondary text (#A3A3A3) meet WCAG AA/AAA against #0A0A0A background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-explore').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, floating headers, or overlays.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable. Customize them to fit the Linear/Vercel dark theme (remove heavy shadows, use crisp 1px borders).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle border opacities.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs).
Ensure the application strictly follows a dark-mode only or dark-default theme as requested by the user.
